methodology: Mobile full audit (technical UX areas) from completed crawl in data/ux-manifest.json (iPhone 13: 67 unique URLs, Pixel 7: 67 URLs), programmatic playwright checks at mobile viewports, and evidence under evidence/ux/iphone-13/ and evidence/ux/pixel-7/. Calibration-first against scripts/ux_rubric.py tier anchors. Cross-device issues reference the desktop store (UX-D-###) instead of duplicating.

calibration.issue: mobile menu treatment links covered by overlapping content
calibration.rationale: Rubric calibration verbatim: 'dropdown opens but mis-hits'.
Rubric calibration verbatim: 'search returning 0 results for normal queries'.
Mirrors desktop UX-D-008 (state/city pages 5-15s) but worse on mobile; QA mobile-t12-1785644915-6/7/8/9 measured 8-9s throttled.

findings.title: Mobile pages load in 5 to 23 seconds on both devices
findings.description: State, city and guide pages take 5 to 23 seconds to load on iPhone 13 and Pixel 7, /clinics the slowest at 20 seconds.
findings.notes: UX manifest mobile load_time_ms: iPhone 13 /clinics 20235, /guides/sculptra-vs-filler 16926, /guides/kybella-side-effects 12646, /terms 10980; Pixel 7 /guides/kybella-vs-coolsculpting 22616, /services/chin-filler 13411, /guides/how-to-get-rid-of-a-double-chin 12569, /new-york/new-york-ny 11175. Avg 2487ms (iPhone) / 3048ms (Pixel). Same defect class as desktop UX-D-008 but worse on mobile.

findings.title: Console errors logged on every mobile page, /news worst at 9
findings.description: All mobile pages log console errors on load, /news the worst at 9 per device.
findings.notes: UX manifest mobile: avg console_errors 3.31 (iPhone 13) / 3.04 (Pixel 7); /news 9 on both. Same defect class as desktop UX-D-005 (all 67 desktop pages) and UX-D-004 (/news 23 desktop).

findings.title: Broken CDN images on mobile state, city and news pages
findings.description: State, city and news pages render broken media.alle.com CDN images on mobile, up to 8 per page.
findings.notes: UX manifest mobile broken_images: /new-york 7-8, /news 7, /california 6, /florida 6, /new-york/new-york-ny 6, /clinics 5, /brands/kybella 5. Same defect as desktop UX-D-006 (/news 21) and UX-D-007 (CDN images on 32 pages).

findings.title: Mobile hamburger menu treatment links are covered by overlapping content
findings.description: Tapping a treatment link in the mobile hamburger menu hits overlapping panel content and the menu stays open.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright, iPhone 13 + Pixel 7): after opening the hamburger menu, tapping a[href='/guides/botox'] times out because the element at the tap point is the accordion panel button, not the link; the menu does not navigate. Rubric calibration 'dropdown opens but mis-hits' -> Most Important.

findings.title: Mobile menu links have 18px tap targets below the 44px minimum
findings.description: Mobile hamburger menu links present 18px tap targets, below the 44px WCAG 2.5.8 minimum.
findings.notes: Rubric calibration verbatim '18px tap targets' -> Most Important. QA mobile-t10-1785641370-1 measured 18px menu link tap targets on both devices.

findings.title: Newsletter form inputs lack accessible labels on mobile
findings.description: Newsletter 'First name' and footer 'website' inputs have no accessible label or aria-label on mobile.
findings.notes: Same defect as desktop UX-D-009 (placeholder-only inputs with no label/aria on homepage, /clinics, /search, /contact, /login). QA mobile-t20260612-1785644915-1 confirmed 4 instances across 3 pages on mobile.

findings.title: Mobile site-wide search returns 0 results for a normal brand query
findings.description: Searching 'Botox' on the directory search returns 0 results across providers and clinics on mobile.
findings.notes: Same defect as desktop UX-D-002 (search 0 results, Critical). Rubric calibration 'search returning 0 results for normal queries' -> Critical. Core 'find an injector' journey blocked on mobile.

findings.title: Header and footer navigation links return HTTP 404 on mobile
findings.description: Nine /guides/ and three /services/ links in the header and footer resolve to HTTP 404 on mobile.
findings.notes: Same 12 broken nav links as desktop UX-D-001 (consolidated). QA mobile-t20260609-1785640579-50 confirmed 12 URLs 404 on both mobile devices. Referenced here rather than re-filed.

findings.title: Mobile menu guide links truncate long titles at 143px
findings.description: Mobile menu guide links truncate their titles, clipping 'What Botox Costs in 2026', 'How to Choose an Injector' and 'Red Flags Before Booking' at 143px.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright, iPhone 13 + Pixel 7): in the LEARN accordion, a[href='/guides/botox-cost-2026'] (scrollWidth 163 > clientWidth 143 on iPhone), a[href='/guides/how-to-choose-injector'] (168 > 143), a[href='/guides/red-flags'] (161 > 143). Pixel 7 clientWidth 154 (same 3 links truncated). 13px text-ink-secondary links clip the tail of each title with no ellipsis/truncation affordance. Distinct from desktop UX-D-013 (contrast) - this is a mobile-menu layout clipping issue.

findings.title: Mobile CTA buttons render below the 44px touch target size
findings.description: Mobile CTA buttons such as Ask AI, Subscribe, List and Map render 20 to 42px tall, below the 44px target size.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright, iPhone 13 home): 27 buttons/CTAs, 20 under 44px height. Measured heights: 'Back to top' 20px, 'Ask AI' 28px, suggestion chips ('Botox vs filler?', 'Which filler is right?') 34px, dark-mode toggle 36px, 'Subscribe' 42px, 'List'/'Map' 32px. Distinct from UX-M-005 (accessibility_basics, menu links at 18px) - this finding covers page CTA buttons under buttons_ctas. Same defect class as desktop (UX-D-015 tier discipline) but mobile-specific tap targets.

findings.title: Featured Clinics heading renders larger than sibling sections on mobile
findings.description: The Featured Clinics heading renders at 52px while every other homepage section heading renders at 38px on mobile.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright, iPhone 13 + Pixel 7 home): h2 'Featured Clinics' computed font-size 52px; all other homepage h2s ('Find by state.', 'The numbers.', 'Browse by service', 'Guides', 'Latest News', 'How we verify.', 'Find a verified injector ') 38px. Heading scale inconsistency on the same template.

findings.title: Mobile footer renders 41 links with no heading structure
findings.description: The site-wide mobile footer renders 41 links and 2 buttons with no heading structure, same as desktop.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright, iPhone 13 + Pixel 7): footer contains 41 links and 2 buttons, 0 heading elements (h1-h6). Same defect as desktop UX-D-015; referenced here for mobile coverage rather than re-filed.

observations.note: No horizontal overflow at iPhone 13 (390px) and Pixel 7 (412px) viewports on / and /contact (playwright scrollWidth==clientWidth). Responsive screenshots captured for all 67 pages per device.
Sticky header verified (position sticky, top 0) on mobile / and /clinics. 'Back to top' button present and scrolls to top on click.
Landscape and portrait->landscape orientation reflow verified with no horizontal overflow or overlap by QA mobile-t20260612-1785644915-2/3/4. Recorded as checked for coverage completeness.

All 12 broken links found on mobile are the header/footer navigation 404s filed under navigation (UX-M-008) per calibration, mirroring desktop UX-D-001. No other broken internal or external links observed in the crawl.

In addition to UX-M-004: the hamburger menu opens correctly and the BRANDS/SERVICES/LEARN accordions are present; the defect is specifically that treatment links inside the open menu are covered by overlapping panel content so a tap does not navigate.
html[lang]=en present and exactly one h1 per page across sampled mobile pages. Footer brand mark image has empty alt (single minor instance, below finding threshold).
In addition to UX-M-009: body text scales responsively (18px at 390px viewport), no other truncation or illegible font-size found on / and /contact. UX-M-009 is the only mobile typography defect.

In addition to UX-M-010: primary CTA 'Find a verified injector' hero button is present and above 44px; 20 of 27 homepage CTAs fall below 44px (UX-M-010). Distinct from menu-link tap targets in UX-M-005.
Featured Clinics cards render in a single evenly-spaced column (289px gaps, aligned left edge) on both devices; no overlapping sibling elements detected on home (playwright geometry check).

In addition to UX-M-011: Featured Clinics placeholder clinics (Test Clinic, ABCD Clinic, Rishav's Clinic, Houston TX) render on mobile home, mirroring desktop UX-D-014; the heading-scale inconsistency is the mobile-specific new finding.
Sticky header verified (position sticky, 74px) on mobile; footer mirrors desktop UX-D-015 (41 links, no headings) captured as UX-M-012.
